mechanism_narrative: A 2% quarterly increase in GDP signals strengthening economic growth, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of quarters with 2%+ GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%, signaling tightening monetary policy, S&P 500 forward returns tend to be negative over the next 20 trading days due to increased borrowing costs.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 1.5%).

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 6% and PAYEMS increases by 200k+ in a month, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns tend to be positive over the next 60 trading days due to increased consumer confidence.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in strong labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A 5% monthly increase in INDPRO signals increased industrial production, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to improved business sentiment.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of months with 5%+ INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds $350B, signaling increased retail sales, S&P 500 forward returns tend to be positive over the next 5 trading days due to improved consumer spending.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain negative in > 55% of periods with RSAFS > $350B.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% and CPIAUCSL increases by 0.5%+ in a month, signaling accommodative monetary policy with rising inflation, S&P 500 forward returns tend to be negative over the next 60 trading days due to decreased purchasing power.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in accommodative-inflationary periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.15).

mechanism_narrative: A 1% monthly decrease in UNRATE signals improved labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 45% of months with 1%+ UNRATE decrease.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds 600k units, signaling increased housing market activity, S&P 500 forward returns tend to be positive over the next 5 trading days due to improved economic sentiment.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain negative in > 50% of periods with HOUST > 600k.
